intervals.quote: In 1994, it was possible to construct the seven-layer, 0.5 million channel, silicon micro-pattern pixel detector telescope that allowed for electronically imaging the tracks on the lead-ion event in the WA97 experiment

name: WA97 pixel telescope and Omega spectrometer

placements.quote: WA97 was the first experiment in high-energy physics which made use of this new technique.

summary.plain: A silicon pixel detector telescope placed close to the target inside the Omega magnet, which imaged the tracks of strange particles in lead-lead collisions with unprecedented detail.
summary.technical: WA97 in the Omega spectrometer: seven-layer silicon micro-pattern pixel telescope (0.5 million channels) interleaved with ten silicon microstrip planes, above the beam line pointing at the target; Omega2 pixel readout chips.

technology.quote: In 1994, it was possible to construct the seven-layer, 0.5 million channel, silicon micro-pattern pixel detector telescope that allowed for electronically imaging the tracks on the lead-ion event in the WA97 experiment
technology.value: Silicon pixel telescope with microstrip planes inside the Omega superconducting magnet
